description: Enqueue a fresh deterministic analysis run for a saved project. Pass `projectId`, or `project` with the name the user said; with neither, the result lists their projects and nothing is queued. Returns immediately with `agentStatus` (`queued`, `running`, `current`, `failed`, or `none`) and a receipt id; does not block on completion. Irreversible: a queued run cannot be un-queued from MCP. Re-check with `getProjectContext`, but no more than once every 15 seconds — it is a multi-query bundle, not a status endpoint.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

project.description: Project name to match, when you do not have the UUID. Case-insensitive; an exact name wins over a partial one. Matching more than one lists the candidates instead of guessing.

projectId.description: Project UUID. Omit if you pass `project`.

name: runFeasibilityAnalysis
title: Run project feasibility analysis
